newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares dip, trend set by foreign bourses.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares dip, trend set by foreign bourses.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Shares dipped, taking their direction from foreign bourses which are expected to continue setting the tone on Thursday.

*Turnover was swollen by a 430,000-share block trade in Banco Portugues de Investimento -- equal to one percent of the group's capital -- which attributed to portfolio shuffling within the existing group of shareholders.
* .PSI20 slips 0.21 percent to 4,779.28. Futures also ease.
*BPI, Portugal Telecom and Cimpor account for 75 percent of the 5.9 billion escudos of turnover.

*Cimpor was the most heavily-traded share, easing 0.89 percent to 3,246 escudos ($21) on the first day of trade in the domestic part of this week's privatisation. Traders said it could find support around the 3,250 level.
